```yaml
name: PR Closer

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 0 * * *'  # Runs daily at midnight UTC
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  pull-requests: write
  contents: read

jobs:
  close-prs:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Install gh CLI
        uses: cli/cli@v2
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

      - name: Close stale PRs
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        run: |
          #!/usr/bin/env bash
          set -euo pipefail
          now=$(date +%s)

          gh pr list --state open --limit 1000 --json number,author,labels,createdAt | \
          jq -r --argjson now "$now" '
            .[] |
            select(.author.login != "jdx") |
            select(.labels | map(.name) | index("keep-open") | not) |
            select((($now - (.createdAt | fromdateiso8601)) / 86400) > 30) |
            .number
          ' | while read -r pr; do
            echo "Closing PR #$pr"
            gh pr close "$pr" --comment "This PR has been automatically closed due to inactivity. If you wish to reopen, please comment or open a new PR."
          done
```
